answer.rule: Render verbatim; do not synthesize or expand claims.

key_facts.rule: Use normalized values only as labels; null and not_disclosed remain explicit.

declared_thesis.rule: Keep an entity's declared thesis separate from directory observations.

observed_signals.rule: Label portfolio or activity observations as observations, not declared scope.

sources.rule: Preserve source title, URL, kind, order and repetition.

verification.rule: Display the date as a verification date, never as a promise of current availability.
